core/models.Field.title: Field options
core/models.Field.intro: All model kinds use this declaration. NewField and the named constructors start with Editable=true; a raw Field literal does not. Auto fields become noneditable primary keys, and Generated is noneditable. Options run in order, so a later option replaces an earlier value. Schema metadata is not a guarantee that every backend or UI supports it.

fields.Name: Required logical field identifier used by queries, forms and serializers. Must be a valid identifier and unique within the schema.
fields.StructField: Go struct member used by record binding; empty uses Name. WithStructField maps a lowercase database name to an exported Go member.
fields.Column: Database column name; empty uses Name. WithColumn changes storage naming without changing the public field name.
fields.Kind: Required field kind. Use a named constructor, or NewField for advanced kinds. Unknown kinds fail schema validation.
fields.Null: False by default. Nullable permits nil and nullable database storage; use a compatible Go representation such as *string.
fields.Blank: False by default. Optional permits empty values during validation; it does not also allow database NULL.
fields.Editable: True from constructors, false in a raw literal. ReadOnly disables ordinary editing; it is not a confidentiality or authorization rule.
fields.PrimaryKey: Marks a primary-key component. Auto constructors enable it. Schema.PrimaryKey can explicitly select an ordered composite key.
fields.Unique: Requests database uniqueness and participates in explicit uniqueness validation. A pre-save check cannot replace the database constraint.
fields.DBIndex: Requests a database index. False by default except SlugField, which enables it; use WithDBIndex(false) to override.
fields.AutoNow: Populate the current time during supported save preparation. Makes the field noneditable; not a database trigger or a promise for bulk/raw operations.
fields.AutoNowAdd: Populate creation time during supported insert preparation. Makes the field noneditable; does not replace database-side defaults.
fields.Label: Human-facing field label used by presentation adapters. Empty lets the consumer derive a label.
fields.HelpText: Human-facing help text; does not add validation. Presentation code must escape untrusted content.
fields.Comment: Database/documentation comment metadata. Check the selected migration operation and backend before relying on its persistence.
fields.Collation: Database collation metadata for compatible text types and backends; does not normalize Go strings.
fields.Tablespace: Backend-specific tablespace metadata. Requires a supported migration path and an existing configured database tablespace.
fields.MaxLength: Maximum text length in Unicode code points during cleaning; zero leaves it unbounded at this layer. SlugField defaults to 50.
fields.MinLength: Minimum nonempty text length in Unicode code points; zero disables the bound. Cannot exceed a positive MaxLength.
fields.MaxDigits: Required positive total precision for Decimal. DecimalField takes it as the digits argument.
fields.DecimalPlaces: Decimal fractional precision, from zero through MaxDigits. Excess precision is rejected rather than silently rounded.
fields.Min: Optional inclusive lower value bound used by supported scalar cleaning; nil adds no custom bound.
fields.Max: Optional inclusive upper value bound used by supported scalar cleaning; nil adds no custom bound.
fields.Choices: Allowed value/label pairs. Values constrain cleaned input; labels are presentation metadata. Empty adds no choice restriction.
fields.Default: Static application default. WithDefault sets it; do not use a shared mutable value as request-local state.
fields.DefaultFunc: Callable application default, set with WithDefaultFunc. Must have a stable DefaultID so schema changes can be identified.
fields.DefaultID: Stable identity for DefaultFunc; required when that callback is supplied. It is not executable source stored in a migration.
fields.DBDefault: Explicit database-default expression. Distinct from an application default; use only trusted, backend-supported SQL expressions.
fields.GeneratedExpression: Trusted expression for a generated field. Requires compatible generated-column type metadata and backend capabilities.
fields.Validators: Context-aware validation callbacks added by WithValidators. Called during explicit cleaning; model declaration alone does not invoke them.
fields.Codec: Application encode/decode adapter. Does not automatically add an unsupported database type, form widget or serializer.
fields.Relation: Target, deletion and reverse/through metadata. Required for ForeignKey, OneToOne and ManyToMany.
fields.Element: Element field for Array; required by schema validation. Also supplies generated-column type metadata where the backend supports it.
fields.RangeType: Underlying kind for backend range mapping. Type mapping alone does not provide a complete range value codec.
fields.UniqueForDate: Date field used for date-scoped uniqueness checks by a compatible ConstraintChecker; empty disables this check.
fields.UniqueForMonth: Date field used for month-scoped uniqueness checks; not a standalone concurrency-safe database constraint.
fields.UniqueForYear: Date field used for year-scoped uniqueness checks; invoke the configured checker during validation.

core/models.Relation.title: Relation options
core/models.Relation.intro: A relation targets a registered app.Model schema. Registry resolution, database existence, object authorization and deletion planning are separate checks. Declare relations before freezing the model registry.

fields.Target: Required registered schema key, such as catalog.Product. Not a table name or a user-supplied SQL fragment.
fields.TargetFields: Target key fields in mapping order; empty uses the target primary key. Composite relations require a supported matching mapping.
fields.OnDelete: Deletion policy: CASCADE, PROTECT, RESTRICT, SET_NULL, SET_DEFAULT or DO_NOTHING. Select it explicitly for stored relations; SET_NULL requires a nullable source.
fields.Through: Explicit intermediary model for many-to-many relations; empty allows the registry to create its intermediary schema.
fields.ThroughFields: Ordered source/target foreign-key fields on an explicit intermediary, resolving ambiguity when it has multiple relations.
fields.NoConstraint: Suppresses database foreign-key constraint metadata where supported. Does not authorize missing or out-of-scope relation targets.

core/forms.Field.title: Field options
core/forms.Field.intro: NewField(name, kind) creates a required field. A raw Field literal leaves Required=false. Binding, validation and rendering are distinct: unbound forms are not submitted data, and widgets never replace server-side cleaning. Callbacks must honor context and current actor scope.

fields.Name: Field name before a form prefix is applied; names must be unique within a form.
fields.Kind: Selects one of the 29 typed cleaners. Unknown kinds fail rather than using an arbitrary conversion.
fields.Required: True from NewField. Rejects empty cleaned input; for Boolean it requires an affirmative value. Set false for an ordinary optional checkbox.
fields.Disabled: Uses trusted initial data rather than accepting the submitted value, and renders a disabled control. Still apply write authorization.
fields.Initial: Value shown before submission and used for disabled fields. It is not a replacement for missing data in an enabled bound field.
fields.Label: Visible label. Empty derives a label from Name with underscores replaced by spaces.
fields.HelpText: Escaped guidance associated with the rendered input; adds no validation by itself.
fields.MinLength: Minimum nonempty string length in Unicode code points; zero disables this bound.
fields.MaxLength: Maximum nonempty string length in Unicode code points; zero disables this bound.
fields.MinValue: Optional inclusive numeric lower bound. Use a pointer to distinguish zero from no bound.
fields.MaxValue: Optional inclusive numeric upper bound; nil disables it.
fields.MaxDigits: Total decimal precision. Configure it for Decimal fields; cleaned decimals remain exact strings.
fields.DecimalPlaces: Allowed fractional decimal digits; excess precision is a validation error, not implicit rounding.
fields.Choices: Allowed choice values and display labels. Multiple-choice input is validated against this list.
fields.Validators: Additional validators run after conversion and built-in bounds for nonempty values; their failures become field errors.
fields.Clean: Optional final field callback that can normalize the cleaned value or return an error. Runs after built-in checks.
fields.Coerce: String-to-value conversion for typed choice kinds, after membership validation. It does not authorize relation IDs.
fields.Pattern: Regular expression for Regex fields. Supply a compiled expression and anchor it when the whole value must match.
fields.InputFormats: Accepted Go time layouts for date/time input. Empty uses the kind's built-in layouts; timezone conversion uses the form context.
fields.Widget: Rendering implementation. Nil chooses a kind-appropriate InputWidget or MultiWidget; does not change the cleaner.
fields.ErrorMessages: Map from validation code to replacement text, such as required or invalid. Does not suppress validation or change error codes.
fields.Fields: Component declarations for MultiValue/Combo; SplitDateTime has date/time defaults when absent.
fields.Compress: Combines cleaned composite components into one value; return an error when their combination is invalid.
fields.MaxBytes: Upload byte limit for File/Image fields. Also bound HTTP multipart parsing; validation alone does not persist a file.

core/forms.ModelFormOptions.title: Model forms
core/forms.ModelFormOptions.intro: NewModelForm requires a non-nil context, bound record and explicit nonempty Fields allowlist. Validation does not persist data. Saving requires a ModelPersistence implementation that keeps parent and relation writes in the same real transaction.

fields.Fields: Required ordered allowlist of model field names. Unknown or duplicate names fail construction.
fields.Exclude: Removes names from Fields; does not expand the allowlist.
fields.Readonly: Removes fields from writable form binding, in addition to noneditable model fields.
fields.Overrides: Replaces derived declarations by field name, including kinds without a default mapping. The model field name is retained.
fields.ResolveRelation: Resolves and authorizes submitted IDs against current scope. Missing resolution fails relation validation closed.
fields.Checker: Uniqueness/constraint checker used during model validation. Keep database constraints for concurrent writes.
fields.Persistence: Atomic parent-and-relations persistence implementation. Must pass the transaction context into its save callbacks.

core/forms.FormSetOptions.title: Formsets
core/forms.FormSetOptions.intro: BindFormSet validates TOTAL_FORMS and INITIAL_FORMS before allocating rows. Submitted identities cannot expand the trusted ExistingIDs set. Formset validity is not write authorization or persistence.

fields.Prefix: Management and row prefix; empty defaults to form, producing form-TOTAL_FORMS and form-0-field.
fields.Minimum: Minimum retained row count; defaults to zero and must not exceed Maximum.
fields.Maximum: Maximum retained row count; zero uses AbsoluteMaximum. Must not exceed the allocation cap.
fields.AbsoluteMaximum: Pre-allocation row cap; zero becomes 1000. Valid range is 1 through 1000.
fields.CanDelete: Enables submitted row deletion markers. Existing-row deletion still uses CanDeleteRow when configured.
fields.CanOrder: Enables submitted ordering and records ordered row indexes; does not save database ordering automatically.
fields.Initial: Trusted initial maps for existing rows. Their count must match the submitted INITIAL_FORMS count.
fields.IdentityField: Row identity field name; empty defaults to id. New rows cannot submit an existing identity when identity checking is enabled.
fields.CanDeleteRow: Authorizes deletion of a particular existing row identity; return an error to deny.
fields.Clean: Cross-form validation callback after individual forms have been processed. Return safe validation errors.

core/forms.InputWidget.title: Input widgets
core/forms.InputWidget.intro: Widgets render escaped HTML; they do not validate or save data. Password widgets do not echo submitted passwords. Labels and error associations come from BoundField.

fields.Type: Empty defaults to text. Supported: text, number, email, url, password, hidden, multiple-hidden, file, textarea, date, datetime-local, time, checkbox, select, select-multiple, radio, checkbox-multiple. Unsupported types return an error.
fields.Attrs: Additional permitted HTML attributes. Values are escaped; unsafe attributes are rejected. Configure step explicitly to override numeric/time defaults.

core/forms.MultiWidget.title: MultiWidget
core/forms.MultiWidget.intro: Composite controls use field_0, field_1 and corresponding label/error IDs. The component declarations must agree with the binding field.

fields.Widgets: Optional widget per component. Empty chooses component defaults; a supplied list must match the number of fields.
fields.Decompress: Converts the presentation value to component values. Without it, slices/arrays are split and SplitDateTime accepts time.Time.

core/api.Field.title: Field options
core/api.Field.intro: Serializer input and output are independent. Constructors set useful defaults; a raw Field literal does not. New freezes declarations. A valid nested value is not permission to write nested database records.

fields.Name: Public wire-field name; must be unique in the serializer.
fields.Source: Record/value source name; empty uses Name. Input maps to this source and output reads it from ValueReader.
fields.Label: Human-facing schema/display label; does not change the wire name.
fields.Required: Missing input fails full validation. Partial binding skips absent fields; constructors derive requiredness from model blank/default metadata.
fields.ReadOnly: Include only in output; Validate ignores caller input for this declared field. Must not also be WriteOnly or Hidden. Use mutation policies to reject forbidden writes explicitly.
fields.WriteOnly: Accept input but omit it from output; use for sensitive input. Does not authorize storing or logging it.
fields.Hidden: Ignores caller input and omits output. A trusted Default is required and supplies the internal value during full binding; partial binding skips absent/defaulted values.
fields.AllowNull: Permits explicit nil values. Separate from missing input and Required.
fields.Default: Context-aware value for absent input during full binding; absent fields in Partial mode skip defaults. Hidden defaults remain server-controlled.
fields.Model: Scalar cleaning metadata. Set through a scalar constructor or Scalar(modelField); does not expose the rest of a model.
fields.Element: Item declaration for list/dictionary values. Apply child bounds and validation as well as collection limits.
fields.Nested: Serializer for a nested object. Does not perform nested database persistence.
fields.Dictionary: Treat the collection as a string-keyed dictionary; DictField enables it and supplies Element.
fields.MinItems: Minimum collection size; zero imposes no positive minimum.
fields.MaxItems: Maximum collection size. ListField/DictField accept it explicitly; zero normalizes to 1000 for fields with Element. Negative values or a positive limit below MinItems fail construction.
fields.Validate: Field-level cleaning/validation callback; returns the normalized value or a safe validation error.
fields.Represent: Custom output transformation. Supply OutputSchema when the wire type cannot otherwise be determined.
fields.Compute: Derives a read-only value from ValueReader. ComputedField enables ReadOnly; do not expose hidden data through this callback.

core/api.Definition.title: Definition
core/api.Definition.intro: Pass Definition to api.New, check its error, then use the immutable Serializer to validate and represent values.

fields.Fields: Explicit public field allowlist; duplicate names and conflicting write sources fail construction.
fields.Validate: Whole-object validation after field cleaning, for rules involving multiple values.
fields.AllowUnknown: False rejects undeclared input keys. True ignores them rather than treating them as declared writable fields.

core/api.BindOptions.title: Partial input
core/api.BindOptions.intro: Validate returns cleaned values and field errors; it does not save a record or grant mutation permission.

fields.Partial: False validates full input and applies defaults. True skips absent fields, including their defaults; present invalid or forbidden fields still fail. Use for PATCH, not as an authorization bypass.

admin.ModelAdmin.title: Model options
admin.ModelAdmin.intro: Register ModelAdmin before the site handler freezes registration. Every callback runs inside the site's trusted policy boundary; model-level rules may narrow but never widen global access. Nil, empty and zero are not interchangeable for every option.

fields.Schema: Required model declaration registered with the site's scoped store; validate fields and capabilities before serving.
fields.Factory: Optional typed fresh-model constructor for stores that need it. It must return the registered model, never a shared mutable object.
fields.Fields: Explicit ordered form-field selection. Cannot be combined with Fieldsets; prefer an allowlist for sensitive models.
fields.Exclude: Fields omitted from form construction; does not grant permission for other fields.
fields.ReadonlyFields: Displayed without accepting edits. May be extended per request/object by GetReadonlyFields.
fields.AutocompleteFields: Relations presented with authorized scoped search. Requires compatible relation declarations and target permissions.
fields.RawIDFields: Relations presented as explicit IDs with authorized lookup; cannot overlap AutocompleteFields.
fields.ListDisplay: Ordered stored fields or registered display-column names. Controls presentation, not row scope.
fields.ListDisplayLinks: Columns that link to the change form. Editable cells cannot also be change links.
fields.SearchFields: Allowlisted model search fields; empty disables search. Counts/results remain inside the scoped store.
fields.ListFilter: Declared field filters shown on the list. Requests cannot introduce arbitrary query fields.
fields.Ordering: Default ordering fields; prefix a field with minus for descending. Independent of the user-sort allowlist.
fields.ListEditable: Displayed stored scalar fields editable from the list. Excludes relations, files/images, protected fields and account-domain forms; signed manifests reject stale or tampered submissions.
fields.ListPerPage: Rows per normal page; zero defaults to 100. Valid range 1 through 1000.
fields.ListMaxShowAll: Bound for show-all mode; zero defaults to 1000. Must be at least ListPerPage and no more than 1000.
fields.Fieldsets: Ordered named form sections with fields, descriptions and classes. Alternative to Fields, not an extra allowlist.
fields.Inlines: Explicit child-model editors with parent ownership, bounded counts and relation validation.
fields.Columns: Computed display columns with callbacks and optional stored-field ordering mappings.
fields.Actions: Named bulk operations with permission, confirmation and a scoped Run callback. Recheck current rows on submission.
fields.SensitiveFields: Fields excluded from unsafe generic exposure paths. Explicitly review forms, list columns and callbacks for disclosure.
fields.FormOverrides: Per-field form declarations for supported custom validation/widgets. Does not permit protected or out-of-scope writes.
fields.ConstraintChecker: Database uniqueness/constraint checks for model forms. Provider failures must not be reported as ordinary input errors.
fields.GetReadonlyFields: Request/object-specific additional readonly fields. Returned names are validated and cannot restore a globally protected write.
fields.ResolveRelation: Resolve and authorize every submitted target ID against current scope. UI choices are not trusted authorization evidence.
fields.SaveModel: Custom parent persistence hook using the supplied ScopedStore; preserve the framework's transaction and audit contract.
fields.SaveRelated: Custom related-save hook in the authorized save flow. Do not escape to an unrestricted global ORM store.

admin.Config.title: Site options
admin.Config.intro: NewSite requires Store, Policy and Signer. It installs CSRF protection for staff operations but does not automatically create accounts, session middleware or login routes.

fields.Name: Site identity; empty defaults to admin. Keep it stable for scoped operations.
fields.Header: Header branding; empty defaults to Gogo administration.
fields.Title: Browser title branding; empty defaults to Gogo Admin.
fields.IndexTitle: Index heading; empty defaults to Site administration.
fields.Prefix: Local absolute mount path with trailing slash; defaults to /admin/. Query strings, fragments, backslashes and doubled slashes are rejected.
fields.SiteURL: Public-site navigation destination; separate from the Admin mount prefix.
fields.LoginURL: Explicit local login route. Setting a URL does not register its handler.
fields.LogoutURL: Explicit local logout route. Wire its handler and safe HTTP methods separately.
fields.PasswordChangeURL: Local password-change route, mounted with the account service and authentication middleware.
fields.PasswordResetURL: Local reset-request route; configure verified delivery and reset-confirmation separately.
fields.Store: Required actor/site/model-scoped persistence adapter; not a global unrestricted database handle.
fields.Policy: Required authoritative site policy, also constrained by token scope. Model authorization can only narrow it.
fields.Signer: Required purpose-bound signer used for protected Admin state. Keys and key rotation are application configuration.
fields.CSRF: CSRF cookie/origin/body configuration. Admin refuses an Exempt callback; do not disable protection for staff mutations.
fields.TemplateLoaders: Optional trusted template loaders consulted before embedded defaults. Nil uses the embedded UI.

async.TaskOptions.title: Task options
async.TaskOptions.intro: These options belong to the registered task definition, shared by compatible producers and workers. They differ from per-message dispatch options. Registration validates limits before freezing the registry.

fields.Queue: Default task queue; empty becomes default. Per-message routing must still select an allowed client queue.
fields.Retry: Execution retry policy. Zero-value policy normalizes to three retries and a 180-second fixed delay; it does not auto-retry every error.
fields.SoftLimit: Cooperative execution deadline; zero adds no task-specific soft limit. Handlers must honor context cancellation.
fields.HardLimit: Hard execution limit requiring a configured executor. Zero disables it; a nonzero limit must not be shorter than SoftLimit.
fields.Hooks: BeforeStart, OnSuccess, OnFailure, OnRetry and AfterReturn callbacks. Keep side effects idempotent across deliveries.
fields.Authorize: Worker-side authorization callback using trusted task context. Return an error to deny execution.
fields.ValidatePayload: Optional raw JSON validation before typed decoding. Payload schema checks still run afterwards.
fields.Rate: Optional task admission rate, explicitly worker-local or distributed. Distributed admission requires Worker.RateLimiter.

async.RetryPolicy.title: Execution retries
async.RetryPolicy.intro: Execution retries are distinct from publication retries and lease-based redelivery. Retry, RetryAfter and RetryAt request another attempt explicitly; ordinary failures retry only when AutoRetryFor matches. A retry scheduled at or after task expiry is refused.

fields.MaxRetries: Nil normalizes to 3. A pointer to zero disables retries; negative values are invalid. Counts retries after the initial attempt.
fields.Unlimited: False by default. True ignores MaxRetries, but does not ignore task expiry or cancellation.
fields.Delay: Fixed delay when Backoff=false; zero normalizes to 180 seconds. Negative durations are invalid.
fields.Backoff: False uses fixed Delay. True uses BackoffFactor multiplied by two to the retry count, capped by BackoffMax.
fields.BackoffFactor: Base duration for exponential backoff; zero normalizes to one second.
fields.BackoffMax: Maximum exponential delay before jitter; zero normalizes to 600 seconds.
fields.DisableJitter: False applies a random fraction to exponential backoff. True retains the full computed delay; fixed delays are unaffected.
fields.AutoRetryFor: Optional predicate selecting ordinary errors for retry. Nil retries only explicit RetryRequest errors.

async.ClientConfig.title: Client options
async.ClientConfig.intro: NewClient requires Registry, Broker and Results, validates routes and snapshots allowlists. It freezes the registry. Optional coordination providers enable only their corresponding features; they do not start background services.

fields.Registry: Required task registry; register all producer-visible names and versions before client construction.
fields.Broker: Required queue publication/reservation provider. No implicit in-process fallback.
fields.Results: Required result-state provider shared with workers and result handles.
fields.Workflows: Durable workflow coordination provider for canvas execution/replacement. Requires its relay and matching result store.
fields.Schedules: Schedule/delay coordination provider. Configure and run the corresponding dispatcher or scheduler separately.
fields.Presence: Worker-presence authority used for scoped inspection; nil leaves that integration unavailable.
fields.Controls: Remote-control authority for fixed supported worker commands; not an arbitrary code-execution channel.
fields.OnEventError: Optional safe observer for event-publication errors; return promptly and never treat observation as execution authority.
fields.EventTimeout: Event observer timeout; zero becomes one second. Valid range is one millisecond through 30 seconds.
fields.Queues: Allowed destination queues; empty becomes the single default queue. Unknown/invalid queue names are rejected.
fields.Routes: Task-name pattern to queue rules; destination queues must exist in Queues and patterns must be valid.
fields.AllowedHeaders: Explicit header-name allowlist. Credential-like names including authorization, cookie, password, secret and token are rejected.
fields.Authorize: Operation/scope/identity policy. Without it, nonempty scopes are denied rather than treated as grants.
fields.Clock: Optional clock; nil uses time.Now. Supply a deterministic clock for tests, not untrusted input.
fields.NewID: Optional task identity factory; nil uses async.NewID. An ID alone does not make external effects idempotent.
fields.PublishRetry: Optional bounded publication-retry policy; distinct from task execution retries. See the Publish retries page.

async.Worker.title: Worker options
async.Worker.intro: Configure the worker before Run. Delivery is at least once: result fencing prevents stale result writes but cannot undo external side effects. Cancellation is cooperative unless an explicitly configured executor provides hard termination.

fields.Registry: Required task definitions with handlers; frozen for execution during initialization.
fields.Broker: Required reservation/acknowledgement provider compatible with the producer.
fields.Results: Required result-state provider shared with the producer and result handles.
fields.ID: Worker identity; empty generates one. Do not reuse an identity to impersonate another live worker.
fields.Queues: Queues to consume; empty defaults to default. Processes can select different queues from the same product binary.
fields.Concurrency: Concurrent reservation/execution cap. Zero uses min(32, CPU count), at least one. Valid range is 1 through 1024.
fields.Lease: Reservation lease duration; zero defaults to 60 seconds. Must be greater than Heartbeat.
fields.Heartbeat: Lease-renewal interval; zero defaults to 20 seconds. Must be positive and shorter than Lease.
fields.Clock: Clock for worker timing; nil uses time.Now.
fields.Jitter: Random fraction for retry backoff; nil uses rand.Float64. Deterministic callbacks are useful in tests.
fields.OnError: Optional operational error observer; callback panics are isolated. Never log sensitive task payloads.
fields.Executor: Optional execution provider. Required by registered hard-limited tasks; subprocess execution is not a hostile-code sandbox.
fields.Events: Optional execution-event observer; telemetry is not an authority to change task outcomes.
fields.Presence: Optional live worker-presence store for inspection. When Controls is set, it must use that same authority.
fields.RateLimiter: Required limiter for distributed task rates. No silent worker-local fallback exists for a distributed declaration.
